verdict.rationale: Synthesia publishes a first-party API reference at docs.synthesia.io/reference covering the Video, Upload, and Billing APIs. It also has a quickstart describing the request/response flow (polling, webhooks, download links) and an llms.txt for the docs. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
